name: Vase
summary: This porcelain vase was made in the kilns of Jingdezhen in Southern China during the early 1700s, at the time of the Kangxi emperor (1662-1722). The colour of its glaze is generally known in Europe with the French term celadon, a distinct type of green with a bluish tone particularly popular
